newsitem.title: CHINA: China hospital logo turning blue in Red Cross row.
newsitem.headline: China hospital logo turning blue in Red Cross row.

text.p: China's hospitals are to adopt a blue cross symbol in a bid to stop the illegal use of the logo of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

"We have to unify the use of the hospitals' symbol in order to ensure no infringements are made upon the Red Cross sign," Xinhua quoted Yi Mei, an official with the Ministry of Public Health, as saying.
Some medical institutions that were not members of the ICRC have illegally used its red cross symbol, Yi said.
China already had a law banning non-ICRC institutions from using the logo, but the regulation had been widely ignored, causing confusion, Yi said.
"Currently in China, many people mistakenly think the red cross indicates a hospital due to wrong use of the sign," he said.
The blue cross symbol would be posted at entrances to hospitals, affixed to the clothing of medical workers and painted on ambulances, Yi said.
Xinhua did not say if the ICRC had complained to Chinese health authorities.
